//: drizzle-kit's config (#372; #331 decision 7). JSON, not drizzle.config.ts: drizzle-kit reads the module's default export, which ADR-0005 (C6) keeps out of apps/web outside src/app. It writes Supabase-named migrations (<timestamp>_<name>.sql) straight into the folder the Supabase CLI applies. Supabase owns its roles; game_api comes from a custom migration, since drizzle-kit can't give a role LOGIN without a password. Generating needs no database: pnpm db:generate, and pnpm db:check in CI.
